June 23, 2018 - By Richard Conner
John A. Levin increased its stake in Bunge Limited (BG) by 49.03% based on its latest 2018Q1 regulatory filing with the SEC. Levin Capital Strategies Lp bought 5,739 shares as the company’s stock declined 7.94% with the market. The hedge fund run by John A. Levin held 17,443 shares of the packaged foods company at the end of 2018Q1, valued at $1.29 million, up from 11,704 at the end of the previous reported quarter. Levin Capital Strategies Lp who had been investing in Bunge Limited for a number of months, seems to be bullish on the $10.08B market cap company. The stock increased 0.66% or $0.47 during the last trading session, reaching $71.52. About 1.30M shares traded. Bunge Limited (NYSE:BG) has declined 15.96% since June 23, 2017 and is downtrending. It has underperformed by 28.53% the S&P500. Reliance Trust decreased its stake in Apple Inc (AAPL) by 6.73% based on its latest 2018Q1 regulatory filing with the SEC. Reliance Trust sold 3,472 shares as the company’s stock rose 5.37% while stock markets declined. The institutional investor held 48,121 shares of the computer manufacturing company at the end of 2018Q1, valued at $8.07 million, down from 51,593 at the end of the previous reported quarter. Reliance Trust who had been investing in Apple Inc for a number of months, seems to be less bullish one the $908.91 billion market cap company. The stock decreased 0.29% or $0.54 during the last trading session, reaching $184.92. About 15.09 million shares traded. Apple Inc. (NASDAQ:AAPL) has risen 22.56% since June 23, 2017 and is uptrending. It has outperformed by 9.99% the S&P500.
